out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. - Observed: the hand sink on service line is used to drain waste water from a tankless water heater.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. - Corrective actions: CFM will obtain plumbing service and correct the violation. JERUSALEM RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 10/19/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: - Observed: shell eggs were stored with shredded mozzarella cheese and above lentil soup and macaroni in walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. - Corrective actions: CFM reorganized the food items in walk-in cooler.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: - Observed: cooked potato (36f) was prepared on 10/11/2026. By the time of inspection, it has been stored in walk-in cooler for more than 7 days.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. - Corrective actions: CFM discarded the food item.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: - Observed: a knife was stored between equipment.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. - Corrective actions: EHS prompted food employee to wash, rinse and sanitize the knife.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment Components, Adjusted per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The door gaskets of the following unit(s) are (missing, damaged): - Observed: the gasket of Alto-Shaam hot box is damaged.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. - Corrective actions: CFM will change the gasket.

violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. - Observed: the bleach test kit was expired.

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Cleaning and Sanitizing
violations.observation: Employees are not properly sanitizing cleaned multiuse equipment and utensils before they are reused. - OBSERVED: a food employee added dish detergent to bleach solution to prepare sanitizer solution in wash basin at 3-compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train his/her employees to properly sanitize all equipment, utensils, and surfaces after being cleaned using either an approved sanitizer at the adequate concentration or heat sanitization at the proper temperature to destroy pathogenic bacteria. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated CFM and prompted CFM to provide appropriate training for food employees. violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. - OBSERVED: the person in charge at the beginning of the inspection is not a certified food manager (CFM).
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM arrived in 10 minutes

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: - OBSERVED: raw frozen shrimp was stored over ice cream in 1-door freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated CFM. CFM rearranged the food items in the freezer.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: - OBSERVED: rice pudding (41f) was prepared 2 days prior to the inspection and stored in the 2-door showcase without date marking.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated CFM and prompted CFM to properly mark the food items.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. - OBSERVED: raw chicken, tomato soup and lentil soup were stored on floor of the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated CFM. CFM relocated the food items.

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED THE COOKED VEGETABLES TO 165F AND DISCARDED ONIONS.

violations.title: Cold Holding

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED BREAD PUDDING
